verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing says users can create custom automation rules, including via Rovo AI, from reminders to rules that move work forward. It also describes automation connecting tools like Bitbucket and Slack to any Jira workflow, which implies a no-code path for a product manager. The evidence is only thin feature-page copy, though, and never shows the rules chaining multiple steps or a visual no-code builder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-step rule chaining (triggers, conditions, actions), a description of the no-code rule builder, independent or hands-on corroboration of PMs building automations.
